name: プロデューサー
text:
美味いな……！
さすが結華おすすめの店
trans:
This blew me away...! Gotta hand it to you, Yuika.
Your suggestion was on point!

name: 結華
text:
でもちょっと語弊があるかな？
おすすめってほど自信を持って誘えてたわけじゃないよ
trans:
But I think you're giving me too much credit?
I can't vouch for something I'm not exactly sure of.

name: 結華
text: ネットでたまたまいいなって思っただけ
trans:
I was just scrolling online and went all,
"Oh, this looks nice."

name: プロデューサー
text:
はは、それでもありがとうだよ
結華の直感の冴えにさ
trans:
Haha, even so, I appreciate it.
You've got a good eye for this kind of thing, Yuika.

name: 結華
text:
おっ、褒め殺し？
もうひとつ頼みたいスイーツでもある？
trans:
My, are you sweet-talking me now?
You really do want to order another dessert, huh?

name: プロデューサー
text:
ああ、実はこっちも気になってて──
いや乗せるな乗せるな
trans:
Why yes, actually I had my eye on this──
No, don't tempt me!

name: 結華
text:
あははっ
好きで乗ったのはそっちじゃん！
trans:
Ahaha!
But you're one who's getting carried away!

name: 結華
text:
（ちょうどいいバレンタインを考えた結果が
『カフェで一緒にチョコスイーツ』──）
trans:
(After all that thinking, my perfect valentines ended
up on "Cafe Time, Shared with Chocolate──)
